[\"[[O0]]语义共享[[C0]] 指 Agent 传递结论、约束、接口约定.en: [[O0]]Semantic sharing[[C0]] refers to an Agent conveying conclusions, constraints, interface agreements, or raw evidence, based on which the receiver can change its actions.

[\"[[O0]]制品共享[[C0]] 指 Agent 通过代码补丁、文件、测试.en: [[O0]]Artifact sharing[[C0]] refers to an Agent handing over work through code patches, files, test logs, or retrievable records. An artifact existing and another Agent having read it are two separate events.

[\"[[O0]]计算复用[[C0]] 指引擎利用已处理的 token 前缀等状.en: [[O0]]Computation reuse[[C0]] refers to the engine avoiding repeated computation by reusing already processed token prefixes and other state. Whether the same text can reuse KV also depends on the model, prefix position, tokenization, and cache residency.

[\"[[O0]]依赖就绪[[C0]] 指后续工作所需的产物已经可用。任务可以并.en: [[O0]]Dependency readiness[[C0]] means the outputs required for subsequent work are available. Tasks can start concurrently, but some operations still need to wait for an earlier Agent's delivery.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 多个编码 Agent 并行工作时.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] When multiple coding Agents work in parallel, ordinary messages require receivers to remember when to use a finding, and upstream and downstream must also check whether agreements were implemented. AECP assigns a lead to divide modules, then uses two types of structured artifacts to coordinate parallel workers.

[\"[[O0]]知识产物。[[C0]] Worker 提交发现、适用的函数或文.en: [[O0]]Knowledge artifacts.[[C0]] Workers submit findings, applicable functions or files, and optional executable evidence. The harness delivers findings together with tool results when other workers read the relevant code. Findings that fail evidence checks can be withdrawn.

[\"[[O0]]契约产物。[[C0]] 上游声明公开符号和签名。Harness.en: [[O0]]Contract artifacts.[[C0]] Upstream declares public symbols and signatures. The harness generates importable interface stubs so downstream can start development. When upstream submits the implementation, the harness checks interface deviations that can be determined statically. If the contract is revised, downstream following the old agreement must recheck its implementation.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] In repository generation from specifications on Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, the authors report that AECP improves hidden-test pass rates and shortens wall-clock time compared with two team baselines. Compared with a single Agent, it uses more output tokens on average. The first-step ablation against the integrator baseline introduces both a shared workspace and knowledge artifacts, so the comparison cannot be attributed to knowledge delivery alone. The main experiment uses the AWS Strands Agents SDK, with a separate verification run using mini-SWE-agent. Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 5 are called through Bedrock, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 are called through OpenRouter. The underlying engine and hardware are not disclosed.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 常规请求接口看到的是各自完整的.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] The conventional request interface sees each complete prompt individually, so the application's internal relationships of "who produces this content and who consumes it next" are easily lost. Parrot uses [[O1]]Semantic Variable[[C1]] to explicitly mark input and output slots in a prompt. A variable's value can be natural language or code, and producers and consumers establish dependencies through the same variable.

[\"[[O0]]把变量接入请求图。[[C0]] 编排器提交带变量引用的请求。服.en: [[O0]]Integrate variables into the request graph.[[C0]] The orchestrator submits requests with variable references. The server incrementally builds a data dependency graph based on the references, capable of identifying previous outputs, requests that depend on them, and groups of requests that can be executed in parallel.

[\"[[O0]]将应用目标传到请求调度。[[C0]] 以最终输出为观察点分析依.en: [[O0]]Pass application goals to request scheduling.[[C0]] Analyze dependencies with the final output as the observation point, implementing application completion time or throughput goals into request scheduling and batching.

[\"[[O0]]复用共同上下文。[[C0]] 多个消费者若把同一段动态产生的语.en: [[O0]]Reuse common context.[[C0]] If multiple consumers arrange the same segment of dynamically generated semantic variables as a common prefix, the system can share the corresponding KV. Parrot also implements an attention computation path oriented toward shared prefixes.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 论文 §8.4 在一张 A100 上用.en: [[O0]]Main conclusions:[[C0]] Section 8.4 of the paper runs a MetaGPT-style architect, coder, and reviewer workflow on LLaMA 13B on an A100, observing improvements in end-to-end time and KV memory. Shared prefixes, scheduled batches, and specialized attention implementations all contribute to the benefits. The actual measurements compare against baseline systems like FastChat/vLLM at the time of the paper, mainly addressing service efficiency. This set of results does not verify code correctness using a modern repository closed-loop fix. The code is publicly available as ParrotServe, and larger system experiments also include other applications and LLaMA 7B.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 并行 worker 节省的执行时.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] The execution time saved by parallel workers must exceed the overhead of re-exploring context and aligning outputs at the end. SquidAgent generates a subtask dependency graph, estimated output tokens for each task, and estimated coordination tokens for each layer while planning. The dependency graph is grouped by topological layer, and tasks in the same layer can run in parallel once their dependencies are met.

[\"[[O0]]继承上下文。[[C0]] Worker 从负责人的会话分叉，获.en: [[O0]]Inheriting context:[[C0]] Workers fork from the leader's session and obtain existing architectural decisions, constraints, and plans, reducing the need to re-understand the task. The current repository's worktree mode uses session forking with independent branches, while the agent-tool mode delivers plans and agreements to sub-agents.

[\"[[O0]]提前统一约定。[[C0]] 启动并行层前，负责人写出命名、接口.en: [[O0]]Agree on conventions in advance.[[C0]] Before starting a parallel layer, the lead writes out naming, interface, format, and cross-file reference rules to reduce alignment overhead after artifacts are complete.

[\"[[O0]]逐层决定串并行。[[C0]] 设任务预计输出长度为 [[A1].en: [[O0]]Decide serial or parallel layer by layer.[[C0]] Let [[A1]] be the expected output length of a task and [[A2]] the coordination cost; the scheduler compares [[A3]] with [[A4]]. It runs the layer in parallel only when the ratio of the former to the latter exceeds the threshold; otherwise the lead completes it serially. The maximum estimates the parallel critical path, not the total token consumption of all workers.

[\"例如两项任务各预计输出 1,000 token，协调约定需要 100 to.en: For example, if two tasks are each expected to output 1,000 tokens and the coordination agreement requires 100 tokens, the ratio is [[A0]]. The main experiment threshold is 1.9; this layer will execute serially.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] On nine in-house coding, technical writing, and planning tasks, the authors report an average wall-clock speedup of about 2.6x over Claude Code, with delivered words per second increasing by about 2.2x. This throughput definition depends on both artifact length and completion time, while quality is rated separately by Claude Opus 4.6 for each task entry. The execution model is Claude Sonnet 4.6. Generation length is predictive for model-generation-dominated tasks, while tool execution, external API calls, and service queuing still require separate timing. The current evaluation focuses mainly on in-house artifact tasks.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 多个角色共享一个基础模型，并用各.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] When multiple roles share one base model and are specialized with their own LoRA adapters, they still produce different KV for the same history. LoRA represents a weight update with two small matrices [[A1]], giving the projection [[A2]]. LRAgent exploits the observation that base projections are highly similar, splitting the cache into a shareable part and adapter-specific parts.

[\"[[O0]]BaseShared。[[C0]] 对相同历史共享基础 val.en: [[O0]]BaseShared.[[C0]] For the same history, roles share the base value cache and store role-specific differences as low-rank intermediates [[A1]], reconstructing them with [[A2]] when needed. The main configuration applies LoRA to the Q and V projections and shares the key cache. This primarily saves storage; each role must still compute its own low-rank history.

[\"[[O0]]BaseLRShared。[[C0]] 训练各角色共用下投影.en: [[O0]]BaseLRShared.[[C0]] Train the roles to share the down-projection [[A1]] while retaining role-specific up-projections [[A2]]. Both base and low-rank caches are shared, so subsequent roles reuse history and perform prefill only for newly appended content. Layer inputs differ across roles; cross-role cache reuse relies on a similarity approximation.

[\"[[O0]]Flash-LoRA-Attention。[[C0]] 设注意.en: [[O0]]Flash-LoRA-Attention.[[C0]] Let [[A1]] be the attention weights and [[A2]] the low-rank value; [[A3]] changes the computation order. It first performs a weighted sum in the low-rank space and then upscales, avoiding the need to expand full role-specific value caches for all historical tokens.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 作者在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-In.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] In planning/action/reflection three-role question answering with LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, the authors observe that this decomposition preserves accuracy better than directly sharing the entire cache, while reducing GPU memory use and repeated prefill. BaseLRShared requires training adapters with shared [[A1]]. The main system speedups are measured on equal-length trajectories; accuracy is evaluated on HotpotQA and ScienceQA, with additional measured HotpotQA latencies.
